messages:
Alexa (AE): Heads-up — I'm scheduled to send LuminaHealth our RFI bundle at 14:00 PT. Need a quick sanity check on attachments + a short security gap list by EOD.
Devin S.: Copy. Which files are we attaching?
Alexa (AE): Main pack: capability_matrix_v3.xlsx, redwood-rfi-answer-pack.pdf, pricing-tiers-v2.csv, PoC-plan-weekbyweek.md, security-bullet-01.txt.
Marco (Security): Quick note: they explicitly asked about BYOK, HSM integration, and key rotation. Can we include a one-paragraph statement and reference to our HSM SLA?
Nina (Ops): Also they want an ops runbook excerpt and a network peering diagram for the PoC. Lumina will be doing Dedicated capacity so include expected egress numbers per env.
Alexa (AE): Marco can you drop a short BYOK blurb and pointer to the HSM attestation doc? Need it in the PDF.
Marco (Security): Draft blurb: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) via standard KMS APIs (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For Private/VPC and on-prem deployments we support HSMs with documented attestation and rotation processes and provide audit logs for key operations. Hosted BYOK is available via a KMS bridge for per-tenant isolation; a dedicated compliance package is offered upon request." Will paste into security-bullet-01.txt.
Devin S.: For the capability matrix I added a 'serving-fallbacks' column and weighted score for cost vs latency tradeoff. Shared: https://redwood.internal/sheets/BUldG0k (sales+sec access).
Alexa (AE): Lumina asked matrix rows for streaming, function/tool calls, dedicated SLA, VPC private deployment, quantization guide. Ensure Yes/No + caveat cells.
Nina (Ops): Procurement asked about PoC options — can we provide a 3-week and 6-week plan with gating criteria? I'll attach PoC-plan-weekbyweek.md with both options.
Alexa (AE): They also want pricing ceilings for Dedicated. We'll attach pricing-tiers-v2.csv but annotate baseline commit + burst. Devin, can you add example rows showing two commit tiers + burst pricing?
Devin S.: Added two sample rows: "commit-100k-tokens/day" and "commit-1m-tokens/day" with burst costs and a note for estimated tokens/day and latency SLO.
Marco (Security): Uploaded security-bullet-01.txt with the BYOK blurb and a pointer to controls-mapping-lumina.xlsx (work in progress).
rfi-bot: Attachments uploaded: capability_matrix_v3.xlsx, redwood-rfi-answer-pack.pdf, pricing-tiers-v2.csv, PoC-plan-weekbyweek.md, security-bullet-01.txt. SHA256: 3a7f1c9b...9c2d.
Nina (Ops): Blocker: infra provisioning for Dedicated PoC requires their cloud account quota and an IAM role. Request IAM role and account IDs in week 1 gating. I'll add that to the PoC plan.
Alexa (AE): I'll request the IAM role and ask Legal to fast-track an NDA + SOW placeholder.
Devin S.: PoC appendix update: small embedding config they asked for:
```
model: redwood-base-2
quantize: int8
batch_max_tokens: 1024
cache_prefix: true
```
Add to PoC appendix.
Marco (Security): FYI — they asked about FedRAMP. We don't have FedRAMP; offering a controls mapping (SOC2/ISO -> their checklist) is best. I'll start controls-mapping-lumina.xlsx and share tomorrow.
Alexa (AE): Action items: Marco — final security blurb + start controls mapping. Devin — finalize spreadsheet + pricing samples. Nina — add gating note for IAM/quota and peering diagram. I will bundle and send at 14:00 PT.
Nina (Ops): ETA: uploading runbook excerpt and peering diagram in 90 mins.
Marco (Security): ETA: pushing security-bullet-02 with KMS endpoints and attestation excerpt in 45 mins.
Devin S.: ETA: spreadsheet + CSV annotated in 30 mins.
Alexa (AE): Great. If anything slips ping me directly. :thumbsup:
